columns.name: DESCRIPTION_ID
columns.description: The system generated surrogate key for this entry.

columns.name: USE_NO_REPLY_FLAG
columns.description: Stores the flag for whether no-reply or vanity email should be used for the category.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION_CODE
columns.description: Unique code for the description.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Description type based on lookup. The corresponding lookup type is ORA_IRC_DESCRIPTION_TYPE.

columns.name: VISIBILITY_CODE
columns.description: Visibility of this description based on lookup. The corresponding lookup type is ORA_IRC_PUBLISHED_JOB_TYPE.

columns.name: STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Status of this description based on lookup. The corresponding lookup type is ORA_IRC_DESCRIPTION_STATUS.

columns.name: COLLABORATOR_RESP_TYPE_LIST
columns.description: Stores the list of all collaborator responsibility types (ORA_IRC_COLLABORATOR_RESP_TYPE lookup values) that are set on the template level.

columns.name: CAPTURE_INTERACTION
columns.description: This field describes if the interaction will be captured for this content library item

columns.name: MESSAGE_TRACKING_START_DATE
columns.description: The timestamp when the message tracking was enabled

columns.name: MODULE_ID
columns.description: Seed Data Framework: indicates the module that owns the row. A module is an entry in Application Taxonomy such as a Logical Business Area. When the MODULE_ID column exists and the owner of the row is not specified, then the Seed Data Framework will not extract the row as seed data.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: AUDIT_ACTION_TYPE_
columns.description: Action Type - have values like INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE.

columns.name: AUDIT_CHANGE_BIT_MAP_
columns.description: Used to store a bit map of 1s and 0s for each column in the table.

columns.name: AUDIT_IMPERSONATOR_
columns.description: This column contains the Original Impersonator User.
